descFull: Android workstation with native multi-window desktops, X11/Wayland, Termux and MCP automation. Run Linux with Shroot without root or Shizuku, including systemd, Docker and Podman. Package a distribution as an independent Android app (Linux Capsule). Android 14+; managed Desktop 15+.
